description: This file defines the ACLAction class, which manages Access Control List (ACL) actions within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for adding, removing, and managing permissions, as well as handling user access levels and security groups.

classes.name: ACLAction
classes.description: Class representing an ACL action, providing methods for managing access rights, categories, and permissions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the ACLAction class.

methods.name: addActions
methods.description: Adds default ACL actions for a given category and type.

methods.name: removeActions
methods.description: Removes default ACL actions for a given category and type.

methods.name: AccessColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with an access level.

methods.name: AccessName
methods.description: Returns the translated name for an access level.

methods.name: AccessLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with an access level.

methods.name: getAccessOptions
methods.description: Builds options for access levels for a specific action.

methods.name: getDefaultActions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of default ACL actions.

methods.name: getUserActions
methods.description: Returns a list of actions available to a user, including caching and database fallback.

methods.name: langCompare
methods.description: Helper for sorting categories based on translated names.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Determines if a user has access to an action based on ownership, group, and permission levels.

methods.name: userNeedsSecurityGroup
methods.description: Checks if a user needs to be in a security group for an action.

methods.name: userHasAccess
methods.description: Checks if a user has access to a specific action within a category, considering ownership and groups.

methods.name: getUserAccessLevel
methods.description: Returns the access level for a user on a specific category and action.

methods.name: userNeedsOwnership
methods.description: Checks if a user requires ownership to perform an action.

methods.name: setupCategoriesMatrix
methods.description: Prepares categories for display, adding access colors and labels.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the ACL action as an array with key fields.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Populates the ACLAction object from an array.

methods.name: clearSessionCache
methods.description: Clears the session cache of ACL data.
